name: records.search
title: Search the records
description: Finds documents, contacts, accounts and items the person asking may see, by text (a reference such as INV-0138, a name, words of a note) or by an amount, exact (1,234.56) or above or below a bound (> 5k). Returns at most 50, newest first, each with its kind, ID, number, party, date and amount, and how many were found in all. Read one with records.get for its detail.

q.description: What to find: text, or an amount, exact or above or below a bound.

kind.description: Only this kind of record; every kind the person may search when left out.
